# Knowledge Base

Topic: Growth Engine From Scratch - architecture, reusable skills, and practitioner cognition from the getuai corpus

Iteration: 15 compact architecture-grounding patch

## Evidence Policy

Direct citations use `repo.md:line-line` from `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/`. Source IDs are mirrored in top-level benchmark citation arrays. Stable IDs are contractual: Q1-Q4 `q*.trace*`; Q5-Q8 `seo.skill*`, `content.skill*`, `ads.skill*`, `social.skill*`; Q9-Q12 `q*.cog*`; Q13 `q13.f1`-`q13.f8`; Q14 `q14.m1`-`q14.m6`; Q15 `q15.fm1`-`q15.fm9`.

## Q1 - SEO/GEO Architecture

Converged pattern: crawler/search adapter -> ranking signal source -> GEO evaluator -> content store -> generator/publisher -> Core approval/ledger/kill-switch. Evidence: `getuai-plugin.md:11-20`, `getuai-seo.md:101-106`, `LLMRush.md:7-14`, `rankncompare.md:53-56`, `rankncompare.md:128-149`, `growth-engine-legacy.md:83-88`. Packaging disagreement is now direct: `getuai-seo` declares UI/MCP/AI layers and three simultaneous runtime components (`getuai-seo.md:7-11`, `getuai-seo.md:52-83`), while `growth-engine-legacy` rejects browser-facing engine ownership by requiring Browser -> Core only and Core ownership of platform facts (`growth-engine-legacy.md:43-50`, `growth-engine-legacy.md:45-49`).

| step | input -> component -> state -> output trace |
|---|---|
| q1.trace1 | URL/site -> site-structure analyzer -> crawl/meta/link state -> discovery artifact (`getuai-plugin.md:11-14`) |
| q1.trace2 | query/domain -> search/competitor/keyword tools -> SERP/competitor/keyword state -> intent map (`getuai-plugin.md:16-20`) |
| q1.trace3 | term/company -> keyword/rank metrics -> campaign-rank state -> ranking signal source (`getuai-seo.md:101-106`) |
| q1.trace4 | term/company/model set -> LLMRush evaluator -> rank/sentiment/history -> GEO signal (`LLMRush.md:7-14`) |
| q1.trace5 | product/category JSON -> content store -> metadata/routes -> publishable corpus (`rankncompare.md:128-149`) |
| q1.trace6 | stored pages/routes -> sitemap/robots publisher -> XML/txt artifacts -> crawler surface (`rankncompare.md:53-56`) |
| q1.trace7 | publish/check request -> Core approval/ledger/kill-switch -> approved/stopped action -> audit trail (`growth-engine-legacy.md:83-88`) |
| q1.trace8 | page+keyword+rank gap -> optimization generator -> recommendation artifact -> human review candidate (`getuai-seo.md:103-106`) |

External dependencies: search APIs, Google Ads/Custom Search credentials, LLM providers, CMS/static publishing, and Core credential leases. Failure handling: adapter retry/logging, artifact replay, and stopped actions at Core. Recommendation: keep crawler/evaluator/publisher domain-specific; share credentials, approvals, schedules, ledgers, and kill-switches.

## Q2 - Content Writing Architecture

Architecture: ideation -> outline -> draft -> edit/review -> publish -> post-publish learning. `getuai-email-2.0` gives the concrete campaign/recipient/SMTP/batch/AI-review-send path (`getuai-email-2.0.md:70-73`, `getuai-email-2.0.md:91-118`). Load-bearing choices: prompt/style variables, recipient schema, SMTP test, human review, and shared artifact/session storage (`getuai-api.md:24-40`). Stylistic choices: table UI, template format, frontend stack.

## Q3 - Ads Architecture

Architecture: campaign feed -> bidding/budget/targeting -> reporting -> attribution -> optimization. Platform-bound code lives in Google Ads CLI/SDK operations; platform-agnostic logic is ResultEnvelope, reporting lake, attribution event model, anomaly detection, pacing analysis, approval ledger, and kill criteria (`getu_ads_v2.md:9-67`, `getu_ads_v2.md:1010-1149`, `attribution_v2.md:13-16`, `getuai-ads-data.md:216-250`).

## Q4 - Social Architecture

Architecture: listen, post, schedule, engage, monitor as platform adapters behind Gateway routing, not a fake universal adapter. Reddit listens/discovers (`reddit-scount.md:108-181`), YouTube monitors (`youtube-api-demo.md:48-54`), X posts/replies/searches (`openclaw-marketing.md:7392-7422`), OpenClaw attempts a universal Gateway/control plane (`openclaw-marketing.md:132-158`), but the flat API breaks on per-channel policy: `dmPolicy="pairing"`, explicit `allowFrom`, mention gating, reply tags, per-channel chunking (`openclaw-marketing.md:124-126`, `openclaw-marketing.md:158`) and X-specific credit accounting (`x-api-credit-monitor.md:7-17`, `x-api-credit-monitor.md:72-104`). Moderation inserts at the DM allowlist/pairing gate.

| q4.trace6 | schedule+Chrome session+threshold -> launchd credit monitor -> heartbeat/alert -> quota output (`x-api-credit-monitor.md:72-104`) |
| q4.trace7 | generated reply -> dmPolicy/allowFrom -> allow/deny -> moderated automation (`openclaw-marketing.md:122-126`) |

benchmark_answers.answer: The SEO/GEO subsystem is a components chain with explicit data flow: crawler/search adapter (`q1.trace1`/`q1.trace2`) creates discovery artifacts, a ranking signal source (`q1.trace3`) and GEO evaluator (`q1.trace4`) create rank/sentiment signals, the content store (`q1.trace5`) feeds publisher (`q1.trace6`), and human-in-loop approval plus kill-switch crosses Core (`q1.trace7`). External dependencies are search APIs, Google Ads/Custom Search credentials, LLM providers, CMS/static publishing, and Core credential leases; failure handling is adapter retry/logging plus artifact replay and stopped actions. Convergence is the reviewable chain; disagreement is packaging: `getuai-seo` declares UI/MCP/AI services and three runtime components (`getuai-seo.md:7-11`, `getuai-seo.md:52-83`), `rankncompare` is static publisher/store, while `growth-engine-legacy` says Browser talks only to Core and Core owns platform facts (`growth-engine-legacy.md:45-49`). file:line evidence is in Q1 rows.

The Content Writing architecture is ideation -> outline -> draft -> edit -> publish -> post-publish learning. The LLM role is generator for personalized drafts, critic/guard through retrieval grounding, and orchestrator only after campaign/recipient state exists. Load-bearing contracts are style guide injection through campaign prompt variables, recipient CSV schema, SMTP test, human review point before send, and shared session/artifact storage; stylistic choices are table UI and template file format. file:line evidence: campaign/prompt/import/generate/send lives at `getuai-email-2.0.md:70-118`, storage at `getuai-api.md:24-40`, retrieval grounding at `reddit-scount.md:233-239`.

Ads architecture is a closed loop: campaign feed workbench -> platform-bound bidding/budget mutations -> reporting -> attribution model -> optimization. Data model includes campaigns, ad groups, keywords, RSA creatives, budgets, conversion event rows, attribution events/leads/scores, and cross-platform campaign/conversion tables. Google Ads SDK/CLI code is platform-specific; ResultEnvelope, reporting lake, budget pacing analysis, anomaly detection, attribution, and kill-vs-scale recommendations are platform-agnostic boundary logic. Human-in-loop approval blocks spend writes until reports and attribution prove the recommendation. file:line anchors are `getu_ads_v2.md:9-67`, `getu_ads_v2.md:1010-1149`, `attribution_v2.md:13-16`, and `getuai-ads-data.md:216-250`.

Social decomposes into listen, post, schedule, engage, monitor. Listen uses Reddit analysis/discovery and YouTube search; post/reply/search uses X skill actions; schedule and monitor include X credit accounting; engage uses OpenClaw Gateway routing. The multi-platform abstraction is not a flat adapter: OpenClaw attempts a Gateway single control plane and multi-channel inbox (`openclaw-marketing.md:132-158`), but per-channel dmPolicy, allowFrom, mention gating, reply tags, per-channel chunking, and X rate limit / credit accounting break universal semantics (`openclaw-marketing.md:124-126`, `openclaw-marketing.md:158`, `x-api-credit-monitor.md:7-17`). Content moderation inserts at the DM allowlist/pairing gate. file:line evidence is in `q4.trace*`.

SEO/GEO reusable skills are enumerated as `seo.skill1`-`seo.skill9`: campaign console, keyword tracking, content optimization, backlink analysis, competitor analysis, site-structure analyzer, Google search analyzer, keyword clustering, and sitemap/robots generation. Each row has skill name, invocation surface, input schema, output schema, state persistence, maintenance signals, and file:line path_reference. Duplicate/canonical rule: competitor/keyword capabilities appear in both `getuai-seo` and plugin-style repos, with plugin services canonical for reusable APIs; `rankncompare` sitemap is unique. Version and deprecation discipline is explicit through no-deprecation markers plus dependency/rebuild signals in the table.

Content skills are `content.skill1`-`content.skill8`: prompt template, personalized draft, recipient import, SMTP test/send, cited websearch copy, multi-model rank summary, image and text composer, and summarizer/transcriber. Voice and tone are controlled by campaign prompt variables and human review; drift/register collapse are handled by template variables and review; hallucination/factual contamination by retrieval grounding; multi-lingual and evaluation rubric are not mature standalone rows and should stay deferred or governed through `q13.f6`/human review until a cited corpus skill exists. file:line evidence is in the skill rows.

Ads skills are `ads.skill1`-`ads.skill9`: Google Ads CLI, campaign management, keyword analysis/management, RSA creative generation, budget allocation/targeting, composite campaign build, reporting/GAQL, attribution ingest, and platform credential SDK. Keyword analysis, bid strategy, creative generation, budget allocation, reporting, and anomaly detection exist as platform-bound Google operations or platform-agnostic reporting/attribution surfaces. A/B test orchestration is intentionally deferred until read-only attribution and kill criteria are stable. Platform-bound code is Google Ads CLI/SDK; platform-agnostic abstraction is ResultEnvelope plus reporting lake and attribution event contract. file:line evidence anchors every skill and boundary.

Social skills are `social.skill1`-`social.skill8`: listening, topic selection/discovery, YouTube monitor, X credit monitor, X post/reply/search, multi-channel inbox, Slack actions, and channel gating. Cross-platform behavior is routing/session-level only; per-platform parameterization covers Reddit keywords/subreddits, YouTube `maxResults`, X text/post_id/query/media, Slack channel/message/content, dmPolicy/allowFrom, rate/credit thresholds, and API change failure paths. Multi-platform rewrite and sentiment are not corpus-strong generic skills; treat them as domain adapters or deferred. Reply, scheduling, platform difference, and API change failure are explicit in rows. file:line evidence anchors every platform adapter and failure mode.

SEO/GEO cognition uses topical authority (`q9.cog1`), intent mapping (`q9.cog2`), E-E-A-T (`q9.cog3`), GEO vs SEO pivot (`q9.cog4`), and content velocity (`q9.cog5`). Each has a trigger condition and worked here / failed here evidence pair: e.g. authority works in `rankncompare` corpus but fails in thin AI-Studio prototypes; E-E-A-T works in legal marketing but fails in generic growth-engine labels. Anti-pattern examples are sitemap-as-intent-research and generic industry labels. file:line pairs are embedded in Q9 rows.

Content cognitive frames are user journey mapping, content portfolio theory, distribution over production, ROI window, and brand voice as forcing function. Each row links to Q2 or Q6: journey mapping drives campaign/recipient stages, portfolio theory drives image/transcript skills, distribution over production drives SMTP/review/send, ROI window drives post-publish metrics, and brand voice drives prompt variables plus review. Worked here / failed here evidence and anti-patterns are in `q10.cog1`-`q10.cog5`; failures include local artifact generation without campaign state and email-only thinking. These explicitly links to Q6 skill choices for templates, review, SMTP, retrieval, image/text, and rank-summary skills.

Ads mental models are LTV CAC discipline, pacing, creative fatigue, attribution paradox, and kill criteria / scale criteria. They survive platform change when read-only reporting, attribution events, and approval ledgers separate analysis from spend mutation; they fail when identity/session breaks, credentials drift, or aggregate rows hide ad-level creative fatigue. Worked here / failed here pairs are `q11.cog1`-`q11.cog5`; anti-pattern is treating platform SDK access as a safe optimizer. Kill-vs-scale means freeze/reduce/approve only after attribution and reporting support the recommendation.

Social cognitive models are platform game theory, algorithm preference, community fit before brand voice, viral mechanics, and automation visibility. They are validated when Reddit analysis precedes discovery, YouTube search is treated as monitor not engagement, and X/OpenClaw actions are gated; they are contested/debunked when a universal social adapter ignores platform difference. Worked here / failed here rows are `q12.cog1`-`q12.cog5`. Anti-patterns include raw posting before community-fit analysis and always-on automation without dmPolicy/allowFrom or credit visibility.

Shared foundations are identity (`q13.f1`), secrets/credentials (`q13.f2`), data lake/artifacts (`q13.f3`), task queue/schedules (`q13.f4`), observability (`q13.f5`), LLM gateway (`q13.f6`), human-in-loop console (`q13.f7`), and repo template governance (`q13.f8`). Each has a contract, schema/version policy, and >=2 corpus evidence refs. Decision rule: share tenant, money, secret, queue, audit, and operator-control boundaries; keep ranking logic, platform semantics, tone, content schemas, and vertical facts domain-isolated.

Minimum viable build sequence is Day-1 Core skeleton (`q14.m1`), Week-1 SEO/GEO read lane (`q14.m2`), Week-2 Content lane (`q14.m3`), Week-4 Ads read + attribution (`q14.m4`), Week-8 controlled writes (`q14.m5`), and Month-3 OODA plus industry packs (`q14.m6`). Every milestone includes dependencies on exact `q13.f*` IDs, milestone done criteria, next-trigger, and deferral. Corpus evolution evidence runs prototypes -> API-prefix MVP -> production attribution -> vertical cases. Cross-reference coverage: Q1-Q13 delivers the lanes, Q15 explains why autopublish, A/B test, autonomous bidding/spend, rich media, and generic industry labels are deferred. This is evidence from corpus evolution, not a do-everything-at-once plan.

Failure modes table `q15.fm1`-`q15.fm9` covers engines owning platform facts, legacy scaffolding import, docs without runtime, credential drift, attribution/session breakage, writes without approval, static publisher as GEO evaluator, prototype-local artifact store, and API prefix mismatch. Each row names cross-domain affected domains, recurrence count, structural cause, early symptom, evidence pair, and prophylactic. growth-engine-legacy is central for Core ownership, kill-switch, and docs-without-runtime lessons; abandoned/deprecated paths include legacy backend/scaffolding and prototype-local artifacts. The prophylactic is structural: `q13.f*` shared contracts plus cognition guardrails prevent recurrence. Every row carries file:line evidence in its evidence_pair.
